commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question 'How long should deleted notes stay in the trash before auto-purge?' \
  --context 'Storage: each month of trash kept costs about $20/month, so 7d ≈ $5, 30d ≈ $20, 90d ≈ $60.
Support: 85% of restore requests come within 3 weeks of the delete; 7 days would block most restores.
30 days covers that window with a week of margin; 90 days triple-quadruples storage cost for the tail.' \
  --option '30 days' --option '7 days' --option '90 days' \
  --recommended

  --recommended '30 days'
turns.final:
Done. Trash now auto-purges at **30 days**, your pick on the card:

- `src/trash.js` — `purgeTrash()` deletes entries older than the retention (default `TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS = 30`); `startAutoPurge()` runs it immediately and daily, returning a stop function.
- Verified: a 31-day-old note is purged, a 29-day-old one kept; at $20/month per month of trash, this caps the storage cost at ~$20/month while covering the 3-week window where 85% of restore requests land.
